cancelledAtSalon.question: My turn was cancelled while I was at the salon — what should I do?
cancelledAtSalon.answer: If you arrived at the salon and found your turn was cancelled without requesting it, ask the barber or front desk to hold your spot manually, or tap instant support chat below and we'll restore your spot and contact the salon within two minutes.

wrongTime.question: The estimated time was inaccurate and the wait was too long
wrongTime.answer: Queue time is calculated automatically based on average service durations for clients ahead of you. During peak hours or if a client adds a service, a 10-15 minute delay may occur. We update your live time automatically.

noNotification.question: I didn't receive the 'Your turn' notification
noNotification.answer: Make sure you have browser notifications enabled for Beltadreeg and an active WhatsApp number, as we send notifications via the app and WhatsApp simultaneously when only one client is ahead.

leaveQueue.question: How do I leave the queue or cancel my booking?
leaveQueue.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 2 hours before your appointment from the booking details page, or from the queue tracking page by tapping 'Leave queue'.

priceDifference.question: The salon charged me a different price than what's in the app
priceDifference.answer: Prices in Beltadreeg are binding for the salon. If you were charged more than shown, keep your receipt and message support right away; we'll credit the difference to your account upon confirmation.

changePhone.question: How do I change my registered phone number?
changePhone.answer: You can change your number from the 'Personal info' page by clicking 'Change number'. We'll send an OTP confirmation code to your new number to verify it.
